name: draftly-video
description: Draftly product demo video (Remotion). Outside the product repos on purpose.

scripts.render:opening: remotion render src/index.ts DraftlyOpening out/draftly-opening.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 3
scripts.render:full:standalone: remotion render src/index.ts DraftlyFullFilm out/draftly-full-film.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 3
scripts.render:review: remotion render src/index.ts DraftlyDemo out/draftly-review.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --scale 0.666667 --concurrency 3
scripts.render:final: node scripts/check-assets.cjs --final && remotion render src/index.ts DraftlyDemo out/draftly-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 3
